newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0755 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to off 0.200 cent per lb. Lower cash beef prices Wednesday plus talk late futures gains Wednesday were technical and not tied to change in cash fundamentals.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady-0.10 cent lower. Expected lower live cattle may pull feeders down. Also, two consecutive lower closes has some analysts saying the uptrend may be over.

LEAN HOGS - 0.100 - 0.200 cent lower at open. Lower cash pork prices Wednesday and talk of $0.50 to $1.00 per cwt lower cash hogs bearish. Active pork trade at lower prices Wednedsay may turn futures higher after opening.

PORK BELLIES - Off 0.200 to up 0.200 cent. Follow-through selling likely at outset from limit-down closes Wednesday. But bullish weekly CME storage report should turn market higher. Stored supplies declined 366,000 lbs versus forecasts for an increase.
